DeskBot AI

Marketing site and pricing page for DeskBot AI, an AI receptionist for home service businesses. I designed and built both pages.

The home page opens on the cost of missed calls, not on features. A live calculator lets an owner enter their own call volume and see what they lose each month, and the pricing page compares three plans side by side with one clear pick.

  • UX and visual design
  • Interaction design
  • Front-end build
  • Copywriting

Cascadia Collection

A site for a private exotic and luxury car dealer in the foothills of the Cascades. It pairs a near-black palette and brass accents with an editorial serif, opens on a full-screen video hero, and lets visitors filter the inventory by make and body style, sort it, and open a detail page for every car. A private-viewing form closes the page.

  • Visual design
  • Inventory UX
  • Responsive build

Stoke Mountain

A pre-launch site for an indoor ski and snowboard training center near Seattle. A live countdown to opening day leads into a waitlist form, then side-by-side annual and monthly membership cards, prepaid credit packs, and icon grids for the services and amenities, all in a high-energy red on black.

  • Concept
  • Visual design
  • Pricing UX

Brand identity + Webflow site

Royal Results

Identity and website for Royal Results, a digital marketing agency, designed from scratch. The R monogram is one continuous stroke with an offset shadow line, set in horizontal, vertical and square lockups in black, white and green. The site carries it into condensed italic headlines, a lime call to action and services for web design, SEO, paid ads and branding.

A 14-page site for a church: Sunday gatherings, spiritual formation, leadership, life groups, giving, four age ministries, beliefs, baptism and events. Serif headlines sit over full-bleed worship photography, and a full-screen menu puts every ministry one tap away.

Exotic Car Rental

A complete booking flow for a premium rental app: onboarding, browse by body style, vehicle detail with spec tiles for horsepower, 0 to 60 and top speed, date selection, card payment, and live tracking of the car's delivery with time remaining. The prototype is clickable end to end.

Legacy Remodeling

A 16-page clickable site for a full-service remodeling company. The navigation separates homeowner services from B2B work, each service gets its own page with a four-step process and project gallery, and an estimate button stays in the header on every page.

Click through the prototype ↗ All 16 pages in Figma ↗

GLY Media

A landing page for a studio that sells investor-ready prototypes in one week. Outlined and solid type play against each other throughout, hand-drawn icons walk through the four-step process, and tilted marquee bands break up the page.

About

From wireframe to launch.

I'm Mark Ratsko, a UI/UX and brand designer based in Seattle. I design websites, brand identities and mobile apps, starting with wireframes and working up to high-fidelity UI and clickable prototypes.

I design in Figma and build in Webflow or code, so what I hand off is ready to ship.
